verdict.rationale: Flutterwave publishes an API reference section and a first-party Postman collection described as a way to 'quickly explore our APIs without writing code,' which gives runnable examples. There is no evidence that the hosted reference itself is interactive (no in-page try-it console), and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs API explorer with runnable examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: is a great way to quickly explore our APIs without writing code.
